implementation: Junos OS Evolved OpenSSL Cryptographic Module (KBKDF)
description: OpenSSL library implementation providing cryptographic services to Linux user space software components. The module was tested with 64 bit word size. The following cipher implementation is covered: Generic C non-optimized KBKDF implementation.
